```yaml
name: DB Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  test-db-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        db: [postgres, pgbouncer, mysql]

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      pgbouncer:
        image: edoburu/pgbouncer:1.17.0
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/testdb"
          POOL_MODE: "transaction"
          MAX_CLIENT_CONN: "100"
          DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE: "20"
        ports:
          - 6432:6432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -h localhost -p 6432"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        depends_on:
          postgres:
            condition: service_healthy

      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
          MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb
          MYSQL_USER: testuser
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: testpass
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "mysqladmin ping -h localhost"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run DB Integration Tests (Postgres)
        if: matrix.db == 'postgres'
        env:
          DB_TYPE: postgres
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_NAME: testdb
        run: go test -v -tags=integration ./... -run TestPostgres

      - name: Run DB Integration Tests (PgBouncer)
        if: matrix.db == 'pgbouncer'
        env:
          DB_TYPE: postgres
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 6432
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_NAME: testdb
        run: go test -v -tags=integration ./... -run TestPgBouncer

      - name: Run DB Integration Tests (MySQL)
        if: matrix.db == 'mysql'
        env:
          DB_TYPE: mysql
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 3306
          DB_USER: testuser
          DB_PASSWORD: testpass
          DB_NAME: testdb
        run: go test -v -tags=integration ./... -run TestMySQL
```
